proposition: After controlling sleep stage, arousal and baseline neural activity, a preregistered vector of bioenergetic/electrochemical variables reproducibly improves out-of-sample prediction of neural-manifold geometric/information metrics.
assumptions: Each physical quantity preserves its own units and constitutive law.
Neural-manifold metrics are fixed before outcome inspection.
Sleep stage/arousal and neural-activity baselines are explicit controls.
h0: Adding the preregistered bioenergetic/electrochemical vector does not improve replicable out-of-sample prediction beyond the sleep-stage plus neural-activity baseline.
h1: Adding the preregistered vector improves replicable out-of-sample prediction beyond the baseline.
falsifier: No preregistered out-of-sample improvement, effect absorbed by controls/artifacts, unstable sign across cohorts, or failure of independent replication.

protocol.procedure: Choose one ethically accessible sleep dataset/protocol; freeze observables/proxies, preprocessing, embedding, metrics, baseline, model class, threshold and negative controls; compare nested models out of sample; repeat on an independent cohort/environment.

metric: Delta out-of-sample predictive performance for preregistered manifold metrics versus sleep-stage plus neural-activity baseline.

evidence.scope: mathematical invariants only; not biomedical validation

limitations: No biological dataset has been tested for DGM-H1 in this packet.
ATP, membrane potential and osmotic variables may require proxies.
Association does not establish causal direction.
No clinical or therapeutic claim is allowed.
